entries.brief: Create ONE SQUARE original painterly natural beast encyclopedia portrait for SKAZ. Broad sculpted brush shapes, clear anatomically believable silhouette readable at 40px and circular token, moderate detail, soft warm upper-left light, cool dark contours. Three-quarter head and upper shoulders, fills 75% with safe transparent margins around ears and horns. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No text, frame, symbols, scenery, ground, accessories, armor, magic or human figure. A majestic male elk with branching rounded antler tines (NOT flat moose antlers), long tawny face, darker shaggy neck mane and alert ears. Entire antler crown fits inside square, spread compactly above head. Warm brown fur, strong dark nose and gentle attentive eyes.
